name: Lucia
summary: One of the two primary playable protagonists of Grand Theft Auto VI, portrayed navigating high-risk heists and personal survival across Leonida with her partner Jason.
description: Lucia is the first female protagonist in the HD universe of the Grand Theft Auto series. First introduced in the official reveal trailer wearing a prison uniform at the Leonida Department of Corrections, she demonstrates a resilient, calculated, and street-smart persona. Her dynamic with Jason forms the emotional and criminal core of the storyline, operating under a mutual pact of trust in a chaotic modern Vice City.
personality: Pragmatic, resolute, fiercely loyal yet cautious under pressure.
